title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 076
review_goal: Differentiate photo album, picture, and pin variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Photo album cover with one top binding strip above one mountain picture panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a bound album cover capped by a short strip above the image panel.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the stacked photo album when a second back sheet should sit behind the front panel.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the rear sheet with a top binding strip above the picture panel.

items.depicts_observation: Picture frame with one sun dot above two mountain peaks inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a picture frame showing two mountain peaks and one sun dot.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simpler picture frame when only one main peak should dominate the image panel.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a framed landscape with a sun dot and two distinct mountain peaks.

items.depicts_observation: Picture frame with one sun dot above one main mountain peak inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simpler picture frame with one dominant mountain peak.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the two peak picture when the inner landscape should split into two mountains.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot simplifies the landscape to one main mountain peak beneath the sun dot.

items.depicts_observation: Folded pushpin flag with one diagonal shaft crossing the lower left side
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a folded or flag like pushpin shape crossed by a diagonal shaft.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the bell pushpin when the top should widen into a bell cap above a straight stem.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a folded banner like pin shape pierced by one diagonal shaft.

items.depicts_observation: Bell pushpin cap above one straight centered stem below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic pushpin with a bell cap and a straight stem below.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the folded pushpin when the shaft should cross diagonally through a flag shape.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot turns the pin into a bell cap with one straight centered stem.
